description: Figure: the mtACP-binding face of LYRM proteins maps onto fmc1 helix alpha-1 and the LYR motif, while the conserved alpha-3 patch sits ~19 A away on a free face available for a client protein.
code:
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
D = os.getcwd()
cons = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D,'fmc1_cons_with_ACPdist.csv'))
isdf = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(D,'ISD11_ACP_contacts_5WLW.csv'))

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14,9))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2,2, hspace=0.38, wspace=0.26)

# A: ISD11 ground truth
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
sub = isdf[isdf.ri<=60]
c = ['#c0392b' if d<4.5 else '#b0b0b0' for d in sub.dACP]
ax.bar(sub.ri, sub.dACP, color=c, width=0.8)
ax.axhline(4.5, ls='--', c='k', lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel('ISD11 (LYRM4) residue, PDB 5WLW'); ax.set_ylabel('min distance to mtACP (A)')
ax.set_title('A  Ground truth: mtACP binds the LYR face of ISD11', loc='left', fontsize=11)
for r,lab in [(12,'L12'),(13,'Y13'),(14,'R14'),(18,'R18'),(21,'K21')]:
    ax.annotate(lab, (r, isdf.set_index('ri').dACP[r]+0.5), ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#c0392b')

# B: fmc1 conservation vs distance to ACP
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
groups = {'LYR motif V7-Y8-R9':([7,8,9],'#c0392b'),
          'alpha-1 conserved block':([11,12,13,15,16],'#e67e22'),
          'Patch 1 (helix alpha-3)':([65,68,72,75,78,79,80,81],'#2980b9'),
          'Patch 2 (C-terminus)':([98,99,100,103],'#16a085')}
assigned = sum([v[0] for v in groups.values()], [])
rest = cons[~cons.pos.isin(assigned)]
ax.scatter(rest.dACP_model, rest.pct_id, s=18, c='#cccccc', label='other residues')
for k,(pos,col) in groups.items():
    g = cons[cons.pos.isin(pos)]
    ax.scatter(g.dACP_model, g.pct_id, s=60, c=col, edgecolor='k', linewidth=0.5, label=k, zorder=3)
ax.set_xlabel('distance to mtACP after anchored superposition (A)')
ax.set_ylabel('% identity across 38 FMC1 orthologs')
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc='upper right')
ax.set_title('B  Two conserved faces of fmc1, only one of them at ACP', loc='left', fontsize=11)

# C: group distances
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
labs = list(groups.keys()); meds=[]; errs=[]
for k in labs:
    d = cons[cons.pos.isin(groups[k][0])].dACP_model
    meds.append(d.median()); errs.append([d.median()-d.min(), d.max()-d.median()])
errs = np.array(errs).T
ax.barh(range(len(labs)), meds, xerr=errs, color=[groups[k][1] for k in labs],
        edgecolor='k', linewidth=0.5, capsize=4)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(labs))); ax.set_yticklabels(labs, fontsize=9); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.axvline(4.5, ls='--', c='k', lw=1)
ax.set_xlabel('median distance to mtACP (A), bars span min-max')
ax.set_title('C  Patch 1 lies 19 A from the ACP site, patch 2 lies 37 A away', loc='left', fontsize=11)

# D: helix a1 identity, ACP-equivalent positions marked
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
reg = cons[cons.pos.between(2,25)]
acp_eq = set(isdf.loc[isdf.dACP<4.5,'ri']-5)
col = ['#c0392b' if p in acp_eq else '#95a5a6' for p in reg.pos]
ax.bar(reg.pos, reg.pct_id, color=col, width=0.8)
ax.set_xticks(reg.pos); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{a}{p}" for a,p in zip(reg.aa,reg.pos)],
                                           rotation=90, fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylabel('% identity across orthologs')
ax.set_title('D  fmc1 helix alpha-1: red = ISD11 ACP-contact equivalents\n68.3% vs 29.4% identity, Mann-Whitney p = 0.023',
             loc='left', fontsize=11)
plt.show()
